notes.title: Alpha Force Zero early playtest is live!
notes.content:
[p]The playtest is live! This is a test of general game mechanics and enemy interaction. 
[/p][p]There are some temporary or missing assets (audio, sprites, effects) but the fundamentals are there. The game will give you the basics but a better tutorial is in the works

Thank you to everyone who gets a chance to play. I'd love to hear any of your feedback. 

No matter what I hope that you at least have fun![/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Alpha Playtest
notes.content:
[p]There will be an early alpha test scheduled during the first half of August. The playtest will include 3 levels for testing game mechanics and enemy interaction.

More details coming soon![/p]
